endpointPath.description: Filters the returned endpoint sets by the provided endpoint path. groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the Atlas Project to request rate limits for. When this parameter is provided, the limits returned are applicable to the specified project. The requesting user must have the Project Read Only role for the specified project.

orgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the Atlas Organization to request rate limits for. userId.description: A string that identifies the Atlas user to request rate limits for. The ID can for example be the Service Account Client ID or the API Public Key. When this parameter is provided, the limits returned are applicable to the specified  user. The requesting user must be the same as the specified user.

ipAddress.description: An IP address to request rate limits for. When this parameter is provided, the limits returned are applicable to the specified IP address. The requesting user must have the same IP address as the one provided in the request.
